title: 第3章 鸿蒙不灭体气运排名第4章 天级天赋炼气废材
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“杀意，呵呵，有意思。”李如风坐到座位之上，心中已经给南宫烈判了死刑。
一旁，见李如风跟南宫烈不再继续争论，沈星河缓缓站起身来。
紧接着，沈星河向前迈迈出几步，随后开口道：“咳咳，我乃飞仙宗宗主沈星河。”
“今天是飞仙宗三年一次的招收大会。”
“废话我就不再多说，下面正式开始本次的招收大会。”
“凡是年龄不超过二十岁的，想要加入飞仙宗的人，依次排队到境界碑以及天赋石面前检测境界和天赋。”
“只要境界达到炼气六重，就有资格成为外门弟子。”
“若有人能达到筑基期，直接晋升为内门弟子。”
“除此之外，天赋为玄级以及以上的，有机会成为长老亲传弟子。”
“以上便是全部规定，下面，可以开始检测境界和天赋了。”
说完，沈星河便转身坐回到原来的座位上。
紧接着，广场上的人便开始自觉排起队，然后开始境界和天赋的检测。
一开始，基本上都是炼气一二重的人，天赋更是黄级下品，完全不符合进入飞仙宗的要求。
随着检测的人越来越多，渐渐的，终于开始有符合要求的人出现。
与此同时，上方座位上的李如风，正一脸悠然的扫视着下方参加检测的人。
不过看了大半天，李如风依旧没有发现什么特别的人。
“唉，都是天赋一般的人。”见没有什么天赋高的人出现，李如风心中微微叹了一口气。
【“叮！”】
【“检测到特殊签到地点，宗门广场。”】
【“请问宿主大大，是否开始签到？”】

突然之间，系统的声音从李如风脑海中响起。
“哦，特殊签到地点？”
“系统，签到。”
【“叮，签到成功！”】
【“恭喜宿主大大获得鸿蒙不灭体！”】
【“请问是否现在接收？”】
“是。”听到系统的询问，李如风毫不犹豫选择了是。
签到出体质，这还是两年半来，唯一的一次，这让李如风心中有了那么一丝小惊喜。
下一刻，一道庞大的力量进入李如风的身体中。
数息后，李如风顺利融合了鸿蒙不灭体。
这一刻，李如风感觉他的实力至少提升了十倍。
虽然境界依旧是大帝巅峰，但战力远远比之前强大的太多。
“不愧是鸿蒙不灭体，这次签到很赚。”感受着体内的力量，李如风很是满意的点了点头。
“对了系统，你帮我看看下面的这些人中，有没有什么天赋非凡的人？”
“继续等下去，起码要半个多时辰，这也太无聊了。”
就在这时，李如风突然想到了可以让系统帮他寻找天赋不错的人。
这样便可以大大节省等待的功夫。
【“好的，宿主大大。”】
【“不过系统建议直接查看这些人的气运值。”】
content_en:
"Killing intention, haha, interesting." Li Rufeng sat on his seat, already sentencing Nangong Lie to death in his heart.
On the side, seeing Li Rufeng and Nangong Lie no longer arguing, Shen Xinghe slowly stood up.
Immediately afterwards, Shen Xinghe took a few steps forward, and then said: "Ahem, I am Shen Xinghe, the leader of Feixian Sect."
"Today is Feixian Sect's triennial recruitment meeting."
"I won't say any more nonsense. Let's officially start this recruitment meeting."
"Anyone under the age of twenty who wants to join Feixian Sect should line up in front of the realm monument and talent stone to test their realm and talent."
"As long as you reach the sixth level of Qi Refining, you are qualified to become an outer disciple."
"If anyone can reach the foundation building stage, he will be directly promoted to an inner disciple."
"In addition, those with talents of Xuan level and above have the opportunity to become the elder's direct disciples."
"The above are all the regulations. Next, you can start testing the realm and talent."
After saying that, Shen Xinghe turned around and sat back in his original seat.
Immediately afterwards, people in the square began to line up consciously, and then began to test their realm and talent.
At the beginning, they were basically people at the first or second level of Qi refining, and their talents were even lower than the yellow level, which completely did not meet the requirements for entering the Feixian Sect.
As more and more people are tested, gradually, people who meet the requirements finally begin to appear.
At the same time, Li Rufeng, who was sitting in the seat above, was looking at the people taking the test below with a leisurely expression.
However, after looking for a long time, Li Rufeng still didn't find anyone special.
"Alas, they are all people with average talents." Seeing that no one with high talents appeared, Li Rufeng sighed slightly in his heart.
【"Ding!"】
["Special check-in location detected, Zongmen Square."]
["Excuse me, host, do you want to start signing in?"]
Suddenly, the voice of the system sounded in Li Rufeng's mind.
"Oh, special sign-in location?"
"System, sign in."
["Ding, sign in successfully!"]
["Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Hongmeng Immortal Body!"]
["Would you like to receive it now?"]
"Yes." After hearing the system's inquiry, Li Rufeng chose yes without hesitation.
This was the only time in two and a half years that the physical fitness was revealed after signing in, which gave Li Rufeng a little surprise.
The next moment, a huge force entered Li Rufeng's body.
After a few breaths, Li Rufeng successfully merged with the Hongmeng Immortal Body.
At this moment, Li Rufeng felt that his strength had increased at least ten times.
Although his realm is still at the peak of the Great Emperor, his combat power is far more powerful than before.
"As expected of the Hongmeng Immortal Body, this sign-in is very profitable." Feeling the power in his body, Li Rufeng nodded with satisfaction.
"By the way, system, please help me see if any of the people below have any extraordinary talents?"
"If you keep waiting, it will take at least more than half an hour. This is too boring."
At this moment, Li Rufeng suddenly thought that he could ask the system to help him find people with good talents.
This can greatly save the time of waiting.
["Okay, host."]
["However, the system recommends checking the luck values of these people directly."]
